title: Stagnone cross-sensor submerged-vegetation segmentation
description: Code, frozen configurations, aggregate numerical results, and provenance manifests supporting a leakage-controlled cross-sensor comparison of submerged-vegetation mapping models in the Stagnone di Marsala lagoon. Commercial source imagery and coordinate-bearing geospatial products are excluded.
